title: NeoBrutalism website (formerly RetroUI)
lede: The site of a React component library that renamed itself from RetroUI to NeoBrutalism, now in a dark theme.
summary: Dark neo-brutalism: yellow fills, outlined buttons with hard shadows, and a tilted marquee band.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 25 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens. retroui.dev redirected to neobrutalism.com.

styles.note: Passes the fingerprint in a dark theme: 2 px outlines, hard shadows, square corners, and one strong yellow accent.

notice: retroui.dev now redirects here. The earlier banner in the [RetroUI record](ref:retroui-component-library) shows a light theme.
observed: Near-black background with a warm radial glow. The top announcement bar is flat yellow.
Headline in heavy uppercase display type, with “NEOBRUTALISM” set on a flat yellow block.
Get Started is a yellow button with an outline and a hard shadow. Get All Access is dark with a light outline.
A mock agent window has a thin light frame with a yellow hard shadow.
A cream band set at a slight angle carries a monospaced marquee of feature labels.
interpretation: Shows that the style survives a dark theme when outlines, hard shadows, and flat brights stay. It is also evidence that the neo-brutalism name now carries commercial value.
borrow: In dark mode, invert the outline color but keep the hard shadow offset and the flat accent.

images.alt: NeoBrutalism home page in a dark theme: a yellow announcement bar, the headline “Create retro looking UI with NEOBRUTALISM” with the last word on a yellow block, yellow and dark outlined buttons, a framed mock agent window on the right, and a tilted cream marquee band.
images.caption: First viewport of [neobrutalism.com](https://neobrutalism.com/).
